column1: # exebuild/symbols/server.tsv - EXE symbols used by server/ (server.exe reading the EXE across processes). Epic 0590.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, kind, anchor_va, consumer, note. The anchor VA is the symbol's VA in Steam build 4390913
# (DX11 EXE, ImageBase 0x400000). Never write another build's VA here: those are in the local tables (exe_tables setting).
# Format and kinds: research/02-exe-internals/exe-build-table.md section 3. One row per anchor across all files: a
# Ticket 4966: the live-terrain field (srv_liveterrain_exefield.*). The grid constants block 0xD90FBC..0xD9132C (880 B,
# starting at shell.tsv's cam_wrapx) is read whole and parsed by render/src/liveterrain/producer.cpp at fixed offsets.
# The server also uses cam_gridptr (block +0x008), cam_h2w (+0x074) and cam_grid (+0x2B4) of shell.tsv. The lt_* fields
# below are catalogued so that the server can check, per build, that each sits at its build-4390913 offset in the block.
